_comment: Standard reinforcing bar diameters to AS/NZS 4671.
REFERENCE DATA (ASET component 1). Edit this file to match what the office
actually stocks and specifies -- carrying sizes nobody can buy produces
undeliverable designs, and this is the file to prune to prevent that.
fitment_diameters restricts the search space when proposing ligatures, so
that a bar-arrangement query cannot suggest 36 mm ligatures.
